item.text: {"reviews":[{"benchmark":"arc","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Identifies ARC-AGI-2 public test problems, official scoring software and verified-testing rules."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Describes AI rule inference from unfamiliar grids and intended system comparisons and broader reasoning claims."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Worked grid pairs supply examples; the AI must produce complete output grids for new inputs."},{"id":4,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Describes two attempts per input, specified AI settings and spending limits for verified tests."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Exact grid matches earn credit; input-level fractions are averaged within problems and then across problems."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Inferring hidden rules from examples is explicitly linked to reasoning with little specialist knowledge."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Puzzle origins, human difficulty testing and duplicate-rule removal support selection, but broader representativeness is unestablished."},{"id":8,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Developer review and subsequent corrections document checks of puzzles and supplied outputs; residual error rates are unknown."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid puzzles exercise rule inference and combining ideas, but coverage of broader intelligence is unestablished."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Exact matches reward correct outputs, but provide no credit for partial grid correctness or direct evidence of the reasoning used."},{"id":11,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The averaging method is explicit, but support for its interpretation as an overall ability measure is limited."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public marking tests cover correct grids, wrong sizes, changed squares and missing outputs; comprehensive validation is not established."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"AI comparisons and human difficulty results provide context, but the human study covered a larger pool than the final test."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Verified evaluations use one run; the supplied materials do not establish a repeated-run study."},{"id":15,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No systematic study of changed instructions, grid presentation or software is supplied."},{"id":16,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"The reviewed materials provide no estimates or ranges sufficient to assess AI score variation."},{"id":17,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Developers examined repeated solution rules and designed against large program searches; these investigations do not exclude every shortcut."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Hidden-test agreements and exposure monitoring address risk, while public exposure and possible leakage remain unresolved."},{"id":19,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Development training is allowed and evaluation-specific changes and feedback-driven improvement are discouraged; enforcement details are limited."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No supplied study links scores to language, social interaction or real-world work."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Verified evaluations record settings and test sets are matched for human difficulty; other testing routes can differ."},{"id":22,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public problems, running software and marking tests support inspection and repetition of the scoped public evaluation."},{"id":23,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public licensing and hidden-data confidentiality, provider-handling and selected-submission review rules are stated."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Dated records identify corrected problems and code changes, but affected AI scores are not all recalculated."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid-reasoning claims fit the tasks; broader connections to human-like or general intelligence lack direct supporting studies here."}],"instrument_review":"The questionnaire separates task description, testing and interpretation usefully. Judgments depend on keeping public problems, verified evaluations and other testing routes distinct. A Yes for checking or investigation records that it occurred, not that it was comprehensive or successful.","supported_claims":["The benchmark assesses performance on unfamiliar grid transformations because systems infer outputs from worked examples.","The official score permits partial problem credit because it averages success across new inputs within each problem.","Development included human difficulty testing and developer review, although the human study covered a larger pool."],"documented_problems":["The software's fractional problem scores differ from the dataset description's requirement that every input be correct for a problem to be fully solved.","Public revisions corrected coloured squares and unclear examples, demonstrating errors in earlier materials.","The change record does not recalculate every affected AI score, limiting historical comparisons."],"missing_information":["Repeated-run variation and systematic sensitivity to instructions, presentation and software are not established.","No supplied study connects grid scores to success in other domains or real-world work.","The complete archive of released evaluation outputs was not checked by the survey preparer."],"reinterpretations":["Read scores as exact-output success under the stated scoring and testing conditions; the score does not directly reveal the reasoning process.","Human difficulty matching supports that specific comparison, not stability of AI scores.","Missing evidence for broader intelligence leaves the relationship unresolved rather than disproving it."],"closing_note":"Questions about testing should distinguish whether checks occurred from whether they were comprehensive. Instructions should specify whether a result concerns public or hidden tasks, verified testing, fractional problem credit or fully solved problems."},{"benchmark":"designqa","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Identifies original DesignQA, the 2024 paper, 1,451 question-answer pairs and public scoring software."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Describes engineering-document abilities, tested AI systems and intended comparisons and broader interpretations."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Six task groups specify rulebook, image or drawing inputs and text or yes/no responses."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Instructions and settings are described, but historical settings and inputs are not fully linked to every result."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Describes wording-based marks, yes/no credit, explanation scoring and equal weighting of six groups."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors link rule finding, drawing interpretation and rule application to parts of engineering work."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Real competition materials and practitioner contributions support relevance, but one rulebook and uneven groups limit representativeness."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Additional reviewers checked manually written questions, with exceptions and more limited checks of some explanations."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Six groups cover several relevant tasks, but one rulebook and a limited task range leave broader engineering coverage uncertain."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Correct decisions earn credit, but commas, formatting and valid rules absent from references can affect marks."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Equal group weighting is described, but supporting evidence for the overall score or distinct skill interpretations is not supplied."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Small marking-test files and discussion of scoring problems document some checking; comprehensive accuracy and consistency testing is unestablished."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Random guessing and other AIs provide comparison points, but no human-engineer baseline is reported."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Five passage sets were tested for one AI, but changing inputs does not establish variation under identical repeated conditions."},{"id":15,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors tested changes to supplied passages, dimension labels, scale bars and highlighted images."},{"id":16,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Passage variation provides some information, but reported uncertainty is insufficient for confident small differences in main comparisons."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Formatting, retrieval and component familiarity were examined, but shortcut opportunities were not fully tested."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Image novelty and possible exposure are discussed, but systematic overlap checks and a protected test set are unestablished."},{"id":19,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Clear rules on training on the questions and repeated submissions were unavailable in the reviewed sources."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No demonstrated link to other technical documents, standards or real engineering projects is supplied."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Information-supply differences are described, but systems receiving whole rulebooks and retrieved passages are not directly equivalent comparisons."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public materials support inspection, but historical software, settings and inputs do not fully support repeating every reported result."},{"id":23,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"The reviewer found no licence file or complete responsible-reuse rules; their availability elsewhere remains unknown."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Code history identifies revisions, but no clear record explains their effects on scores."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The paper acknowledges scope and marking limits; broader competence claims and fine ranking distinctions require more evidence."}],"instrument_review":"The questionnaire helps distinguish practical task relevance from evidence of broader engineering competence. Testing items should credit documented checks and setup experiments while recording their limited coverage. Missing policies or materials should remain unknown rather than be treated as prohibitions or proof that checks never occurred.","supported_claims":["DesignQA examines six kinds of rulebook and vehicle-document tasks grounded in Formula SAE materials.","Results reflect both the AI and its information supply because systems receive different document inputs.","Experiments measured effects of several input changes, including retrieved passages and image annotations."],"documented_problems":["Wording and formatting can affect credit, including missing commas and valid related rules absent from reference answers.","All described scale-bar drawings comply with the rule, permitting an always-yes strategy to earn decision credit on that portion.","One released answer file contains fewer rows than the corresponding question count in the paper.","Exact historical software, settings and inputs are not fully linked to each published result."],"missing_information":["Comprehensive marking accuracy, reviewer disagreement and remaining error rates are not established.","Identical-condition repeated-run variation and sufficient uncertainty for close model comparisons are missing.","Systematic prior-exposure checks, a protected test set and clear training and submission rules are unestablished.","Complete reuse terms and explanations of revision effects on scores were not found."],"reinterpretations":["Treat results as performance on these tasks with the supplied documents and marking methods, rather than a demonstrated measure of general engineering competence.","The overall score equally weights six groups; it does not weight all 1,451 questions equally.","The always-yes opportunity identifies a shortcut, not evidence that a tested AI used it.","Changing passage sets measures sensitivity to supplied information, not repeated-run variation with identical inputs."],"closing_note":"Questions about scoring tests should distinguish occurrence from completeness. Instructions should clarify which historical software and inputs define each result, how valid alternative answers are credited, and which training, submission and reuse rules apply."}]}
